scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --outdir dist/server && cp -R src/assets dist/server/assets
scripts.deploy: pnpm turbo run build --filter @prisma/example-root-input... && ( set -a; . "${PRISMA_DEPLOY_ENV:-../../.env}"; set +a; bun ../../node_modules/.bin/prisma deploy ${ROOT_INPUT_STACK_NAME:+--name "$ROOT_INPUT_STACK_NAME"} --environment "${ROOT_INPUT_ENVIRONMENT:-production}" --report "${ROOT_INPUT_REPORT:-.prisma/deploy-report.json}" )
